shared_elements: upright stone slab carved in low relief
row of three humanoid/anthropomorphic figures with raised or bent arms in the upper register
large quadruped animal shown in profile in the lower register
small subsidiary human-like figure beside the animal
band of repeated linear/zigzag ornament separating or framing the scene
flat, outlined figures with little interior modelling
justification: Both slabs use the same two-tier scheme: a row of three frontal humanoid figures with raised arms along the top, a horizontal ornamental band beneath them, and a single large quadruped in profile dominating the lower field with a smaller human figure alongside. The manner differs, however: A is coarser and more schematic with irregular, uncarved edges and no frame, while B is a neatly shaped, arched stele with a continuous zigzag border and more articulated, equipped figures.
